name: SSH Client Aliases
body:
> Tool · 2026-10-01

# Summary
Claude reaches client servers through SSH aliases in `C:\Users\kimbe\.ssh\config`. Each server has its own ed25519 key with `IdentitiesOnly yes` (key files are never opened or copied).

| Alias | Host | Status | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `summit` | SiteGround (Summit AZ) | Working | Read-only |
| `alphalete` | Hostinger | Working | Read-only |
| `pipeliners` | Hostinger | **Unverified** (May 18 test interrupted) | Read-only |
| `namehero` | node614.namehero.net:37980, user scottvin | Working | tagmktg.com, Prestige, other sites |

# Rules
- Client WordPress sites are read-only for Claude (Summit, Alphalete, Pipeliners). Output fix lists for Kim to apply.
- Before any server-side write that Kim has authorized, quote her exact instruction.
- Summit (SiteGround): after redirect, slug or trash changes the edge cache must be purged or it serves stale 404s.
- The website connection SOP lives in the Summit folder (`SOP-connect-website.md`) but covers all sites.

# Connection test
`ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o BatchMode=yes <alias> "hostname && whoami"`. If it fails, report the error; do not auto-fix.

# Pending
- Confirm the `pipeliners` alias connects.
